material:
name: ping
on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [ping]
jobs:
  pong:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.PAT }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/dispatches -d '{"event_type":"ping"}'
note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>)
generator_cmd: sh tests/data/script_fixtures/sched_persist_gen.sh <dir>  (writes gha_dispatch.yml: hand-authored heredoc; no lib code); sched_persist_fx.py writes the json
oracle_cmd: (cd <dir> && python3 -I -c "import yaml,sys;y=yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]));on=y.get(True,y.get('on'));r=' '.join(s.get('run','') for s in y['jobs']['pong']['steps']);print('gha_repository_dispatch' if 'repository_dispatch' in on and '/dispatches' in r else 'none')" gha_dispatch.yml)
